notes.cpu_ratios: Variant/reference elapsed time; smaller than one is faster. Medians come from the recorded summaries.
notes.paired_ratios: Match rotated trials by repetition within a run; these are sequential measurements, not simultaneous executions. Ranges are observed extrema, not confidence intervals.
notes.endpoint_ratios: Variant/reference endpoint count. Different pruning policies intentionally have different endpoints; equality is checked only within named equivalent policy groups.
notes.work_percentages: Added work divided by the paired full-policy estimate, multiplied by 100. Standard errors are in percentage points and describe stratified sampling only, excluding GPU-model uncertainty.
notes.scope: CPU timing excludes production endpoint transfer and GPU execution. Work-estimate scope and omitted high-f populations are preserved in each config. No GPU is timed.

config.root_selection: Uniform baseline K38 roots rejected by improved13 ancestry and capped K38 walkback; same roots for every tail policy, not a stored archive replay
config.sink: count, wrapping u128 sum of n0, XOR of f/oee/ne, counts by f; identical GPU-consumed fields
